Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misordered the wavelengths of red and orange light (treating red as shorter than orange), leading to the incorrect temperature ranking (1 > 2 > 3). By Wien’s law, shorter wavelength means hotter, so the correct order is blue > orange > red (Object 1, Object 3, Object 2). The Planner also mismatched the option label by writing “B) Object 1, Object 2, Object 3,” compounding the error.
